issues.on_page: Grants and contributions 153,249 (Statement of Activities: Operating Grants and Contributions)
issues.issue: Mixed label with no printed breakdown and no grantor named; the 2026-11-06 ruling says do not guess a grantor and grants vs donations are separate categories. Same for the detail 'Grants and contributions' lines (Administrative 92,248, Fire 27,445, Library 25, Ambulance 10,681, Cemetery 22,850; pp15-16), e.g. the Cemetery 22,850 may be private gifts.

Inconsistent with the Administrative capital outlay line (detail[37]), which was labelled 'Capital Outlay: General Government' from its department column; the Ambulance column names the function just as clearly (statement counts Ambulance under Public works).

issues.on_page: Ambulance department (statement p6/p7 counts it in Public works 142,672 = Street 120,533 + Ambulance 22,139)
issues.issue: Detail functions disagree with the statement's own grouping: Ambulance lines (detail[69]-[74]) are public safety in detail but Public works (streets/highways) on the statement; Cemetery lines (detail[76]-[81]) are health/welfare in detail but Environment and leisure (culture/recreation) on the statement. Defensible, flagged for consistency.

issues.on_page: Warren Memorial Hospital support (250,000), nonoperating expense, Electric Fund
issues.issue: The cash-flow statement (p10) shows this 250,000 under investing activities, not as a noncapital payment, so it may be an advance/investment rather than a grant. Recorded as printed on the operating statement (an expense); nature not stated.
